exhaust_injury.note: Sec.1110: share of timely suits that pass comment exhaustion + direct injury

suit_payoff.note: Sec.1110: suits filed relative to current law when the only remedy is remand

inj_nonNEPA.note: Sec.1110: share of injunctions that rest on non-NEPA laws (still allowed)

lit_months_baaja.note: Sec.1110/2201: months in litigation with appeals-court original jurisdiction + expedited review

lit_data_mult.note: scale on the energy-specific EA/CE suit rates (renewables, transmission) [D: suits / BLM + DOE reviews, 2012-21]; < 1 because other agencies' reviews are missing from the denominator

lit_ea.note: P(sued | EA) for gas and hydro: all-sector case data x ~10,000 EAs/yr (CEQ estimate)
